text: Solvac SA held 30.81% of Syensqo SA's share capital and voting rights when it crossed the 30% threshold on December 11, 2023, according to the transparency declaration Syensqo cites on its major-shareholders page.

source.name: Syensqo: Share information - Major shareholders (archived copy; syensqo.com blocks scripts)
source.quote: Solvac SA crossed the threshold of 30% upwards on December 11, 2023, holding 30.81% of Syensqo's share capital and therefore 30.81% of voting rights.
